//! Writes `journey_v04.lup` with the PlumSpirit v0.4 engine (commit 298664d):
//! a multichannel track, a single-channel track with properties, an empty track,
//! a tempo ramp, a marker, Onion Skin settings and Mute.
use plumspirit_engine::history::{History, Operation};
use plumspirit_engine::model::conductor::Interp;
use plumspirit_engine::model::project::{OnionConfig, OnionMode};
use plumspirit_engine::model::{
    Bpm, GatePercent, NoteAttrs, NoteOffKind, NoteRecord, PlumDocument, TempoValue, TrackKind,
};
use plumspirit_engine::native::project_to_bytes;

fn n(start: u64, pitch: u8, vel: u8, ch: u8) -> NoteRecord {
    NoteRecord {
        start_tick: start,
        duration_ticks: 240,
        attrs: NoteAttrs::new(pitch, vel, ch, 0, NoteOffKind::NoteOff).unwrap(),
    }
}

fn main() {
    let path = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("output path");
    let mut d = PlumDocument::new_project("Journey v04".into(), Bpm::parse("150").unwrap(), 960);
    let mut h = History::default();
    h.apply(&mut d, Operation::AddTrack).unwrap();
    h.apply(&mut d, Operation::AddTrack).unwrap();
    // Track 1: channels 1, 5 and 10.
    let mut a: Vec<NoteRecord> = (0..24u64)
        .map(|i| n(i * 480, 48 + (i % 12) as u8, 20 + (i * 4) as u8, [0u8, 4, 9][(i % 3) as usize]))
        .collect();
    a.sort_by_key(|r| r.start_tick);
    d.track_mut(0).unwrap().notes.insert_sorted_batch(&a, false).unwrap();
    // Track 2: channel 3 only, with properties (new notes on channel 3, +12 keys).
    let b: Vec<NoteRecord> = (0..8u64).map(|i| n(i * 960, 60 + i as u8, 100, 2)).collect();
    d.track_mut(1).unwrap().notes.insert_sorted_batch(&b, false).unwrap();
    let id1 = d.track(1).unwrap().id();
    let mut props = d.track(1).unwrap().props().clone();
    props.default_channel = 2;
    props.kind = TrackKind::Melody;
    props.key_correction = 12;
    props.gate = GatePercent::from_hundredths(5_000).unwrap();
    h.apply(
        &mut d,
        Operation::TrackProps { track: id1, props, end: None, label: "Track Properties" },
    )
    .unwrap();
    // Conductor: a ramp 150 → 180 over bars 3–5, and a marker.
    let c = d.conductor();
    let e = c
        .prepare_set_tempo(None, 3840 * 2, TempoValue::Bpm(Bpm::parse("150").unwrap()), Interp::Linear)
        .unwrap();
    h.apply(&mut d, Operation::Conductor { edit: e, label: "Tempo" }).unwrap();
    let e = d
        .conductor()
        .prepare_set_tempo(None, 3840 * 4, TempoValue::Bpm(Bpm::parse("180").unwrap()), Interp::Step)
        .unwrap();
    h.apply(&mut d, Operation::Conductor { edit: e, label: "Tempo" }).unwrap();
    // Onion Skin: specific track 2, 50 %; track 3 muted.
    {
        let id = d.track(1).unwrap().id();
        let p = d.project_mut();
        p.onion = OnionConfig { mode: OnionMode::Specific, specific: vec![id], opacity: 50 };
    }
    d.track_mut(2).unwrap().mute = true;
    let bytes = project_to_bytes(&d).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(&path, &bytes).unwrap();
    println!("wrote {path}: {} bytes, {} notes", bytes.len(), d.note_count());
    let plan = plumspirit_engine::midi::plan_export(&d);
    let mid = plumspirit_engine::midi::export_to_bytes_with(&d, &plan).unwrap();
    let mpath = path.replace(".lup", ".mid");
    std::fs::write(&mpath, &mid).unwrap();
    println!("wrote {mpath}: {} bytes", mid.len());
}
